headline.zh:
改了一个文件，
只重算受影响的节点。
headline.en:
One file changed.
Recompute the affected nodes.

sub.zh: 给已有代码图谱加上变更追踪。文件修改后，找出它影响的节点，按依赖顺序重算；无关节点保持原样。
sub.en: Add change tracking to an existing code graph. Find the nodes affected by an edit and re-derive them in dependency order. Leave unrelated nodes alone.

title.zh: 看清一次修改影响了哪里
title.en: See the reach of an edit

body.zh: status --why 区分源文件直接变化与依赖传播，逐节点说明为什么需要重算。
body.en: status --why distinguishes a changed source from its downstream effects and explains why each node is stale.

title.zh: 保留你已经建立的图谱
title.en: Keep the graph you already have

body.zh: 读取 graphify JSON 或 code-review-graph SQLite，用独立状态文件记录变更，不修改导入的原图。
body.en: Read graphify JSON or code-review-graph SQLite. Track changes in separate state files without modifying the imported graph.

body.zh: 只对受影响节点调用 adapter。成功后更新状态；没有新修改时，下一次重算的节点数为零。
body.en: Call the adapter only for affected nodes. Checkpoint successful calls; with no further edit, the next pass re-derives zero nodes.

title.en: Follow a change through the graph

note.zh: 8 个真实源文件构成的演示样例。以下是实际 CLI 输出，不是性能基准。
note.en: A constructed example with 8 real source files. These are actual CLI outputs, not a performance benchmark.

body.zh: 所有源文件与记录一致，当前没有节点需要重算。
body.en: All source files match their checkpoints. No node needs re-derivation.

body.zh: 修改 auth.py 后，auth、session、views、api 需要重算。其余 4 个节点不受影响。
body.en: After editing auth.py, auth, session, views and api need re-derivation. The other 4 nodes are unaffected.

steps.output:
dirty closure: 4 dirty of 8
  changed sources: 1
  direct hits: 1 | propagated: 3
  [propagated] api  via auth -> session -> views -> api
  [direct]    auth  <- source: auth.py
  [propagated] session  via auth -> session
  [propagated] views  via auth -> session -> views

body.zh: 按依赖顺序重算这 4 个节点，成功后更新状态。
body.en: Re-derive the 4 nodes in dependency order and checkpoint successful calls.

steps.output:
dirty closure: 4 dirty of 8
re-derived 4 nodes (of 8)
  + auth
  + session
  + views
  + api

body.zh: 没有新修改，再运行时不会重复重算。
body.en: With no further edit, the next pass re-derives zero nodes.

steps.output:
dirty closure: 0 dirty of 8
re-derived 0 nodes (of 8)

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12 或更高版本。示例自动创建临时目录，结束后清理；不需要 API Key 或模型服务。
body.en: Requires Python 3.12 or later. The example creates and cleans up a temporary directory. No API key or model service is needed.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/dirtygraph.git
cd dirtygraph
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e .

dirtygraph init /path/to/graph.json
cd /path/to
# Edit a source file referenced by the graph.
dirtygraph status --why
dirtygraph rederive --adapter codegraph

limitations.zh: 图谱需要已有的源文件路径和依赖关系；DirtyGraph 不负责从代码推断依赖或构建图谱。
limitations.en: The input graph must include source-file paths and dependency edges. DirtyGraph does not infer dependencies or build the graph.

limitations.zh: 本例验证变更检测与重算范围，不衡量耗时、token 节省或摘要质量。
limitations.en: This example verifies change detection and re-derivation scope, not elapsed time, token savings or summary quality.

limitations.zh: CLI 会更新自身状态，但不会把重算内容写回原图。应用需要在 adapter 中保存派生内容。
limitations.en: The CLI checkpoints its own state but does not write derived content back to the imported graph. Applications must persist derived content in their adapter.
